first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A partially visible dark blue-black long-gun-like weapon in the lower-right foreground, with a box-shaped body, a broad flat top cover, and silver-gray border lines.

entities.name: layered rock wall
entities.identification: Tall greenish-brown rock walls enclosing a narrow passage, with undulating horizontal strata, mottled textures, and angular bends; in the first frame, a bright yellowish-brown rock face is visible in the upper-left area.

entities.name: gray-green passage floor
entities.identification: A gray-green road surface with relatively faint texture between the layered rock walls; in the final segment, a transverse edge and a darker narrow road surface behind it are visible.
